quote.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quote.author: Will Durant, The Story of Philosophy (1926), glossing Aristotle

stories.headline: Judge the Jumper From the Goat Up
stories.dek: Cashmere's price ladder is mostly theatre once you know the two variables that decide it — and the yarn under a four-figure Italian jumper is often spun in the same Scottish shed as a three-hundred-pound one.

stories.headline: The Machine That Makes the Exact Part You Needed — and the Rabbit Hole It Opens
stories.dek: Everyone falls in the same way: not the toy tugboat that comes first, but the first genuinely useful object — a bracket, a drawer divider, a replacement knob you could never buy. That "I just made the thing" hit is the whole hobby's front door.

stories.headline: The War Did Not Cool Over the Weekend — It Hardened Into a Rule
stories.dek: A month of exchanges settled into a doctrine: for every American ship shot at, three Iranian tankers. The off-ramp Tehran offered in Bishkek is still lying on the table, unanswered.

stories.headline: The Sky Turns a Colour the Island Hoped It Had Forgotten
stories.dek: The haze crossed into "unhealthy" for the first time since October 2023 — and the reflex that came back with it, purifiers and N95s and cancelled weekend runs, is muscle memory nobody wanted to keep.

stories.headline: Nvidia Writes MediaTek a Three-and-a-Half-Billion Cheque — and Most of It Lists in Singapore on Tuesday
stories.dek: The held deal moved. Nvidia took nearly ninety per cent of a convertible-bond offering; MediaTek adopts NVLink to build custom accelerators; and the ~US$3.9bn tranche prices onto the Singapore Exchange this week.

stories.headline: Sennheiser's Best Earbuds Yet, and the Buy-Once Feature Is a Screwdriver
stories.dek: The Momentum True Wireless 5 landed its reviews this week at the same price as the 4. The news isn't the sound, though the sound is excellent — it's that you can replace the batteries yourself, in the buds and the case both.

stories.headline: A Two-Hundred-Thousand-Dollar Wireless Tower — and the Four-Thousand-Dollar One That Is the Sane Version
stories.dek: Focal's new Diva Alta Utopia is a halo object priced like a small flat. The interesting speaker this month is the other one: KEF's LS LUXE, a Ross Lovegrove sculpture with flagship guts, at one fifty-second of the price.

stories.headline: Venice Holds Its Lion Until Saturday — So We Print the Heat, Not the Winner
stories.dek: Maggie Gyllenhaal's jury decides on 12 September, after this issue. Two films have the loudest ovations; naming a victor now would be inventing one, so we won't.

stories.headline: A Natural Experiment Separates the Move From the Age — and Finds It Is the Move
stories.dek: When one state shifted secondary-school entry a year, two age cohorts crossed the threshold at once. The dip in a twelve-year-old's wellbeing tracked the transition, not the birthday.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Portfolio Lens
stories.headline: A Hot Jobs Print Flips September From Cut to Hike — and Gold Refuses to Fall the Way the Textbook Says
stories.dek: One hundred and sixty-two thousand jobs, three times what was penciled in, pushed rate-hike odds toward sixty per cent. Yields firmed and the dollar bid, yet gold sits near its highs and bitcoin held eighty thousand. Same force, four sensitivities.

stories.headline: A Hundred-Marathon Cohort, a Five-Fold Mortality Gap — and Why the Best Gains Are at the Bottom
stories.dek: The VO2max obsession has fresh fuel: people who run a hundred marathons hold their cardio-fitness into old age. The catch a mid-40s reader should keep is that the steepest returns are for the unfit, not the elite.

stories.headline: A Widening Route Map, a Slipping First Cabin, and a Ski Hotel That Opened This Week
stories.dek: The weekend's travel news reads two ways at once: Singapore Airlines keeps adding European dots while its billion-dollar new First and Business class slips again into 2027, and Marriott plants a flag at the base of a Niseko gondola.

stories.headline: A Stadium Bookended by Concerts, and a Sumo Tournament to Fly For
stories.dek: The F1 fortnight tops a crowded Singapore calendar; in Japan, the Kyushu Basho and a Musée d'Orsay blockbuster reward the traveller who books the moment tickets open.

stories.headline: 县城贵妇 — the County-Town Socialite, and the China Story Everyone Is Telling From the Wrong City
stories.dek: The West's picture of the Chinese consumer is a demoralised Shanghai renter. The growth is somewhere else entirely: a property-owning, time-rich woman in a fifth-tier county town, quietly outspending the graduate who has the prestige job and none of the security.
